description: Saves where this session stopped and what comes next; resume_session shows it to the next session. Call before ending a work session. Between agents, set `to` (e.g. "qa") to hand the work to that role: its resume_session lists the handoff first.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.

to.description: The agent (role) this handoff is for, e.g. "qa"

name: record_handoff
title: Record a session handoff
